name: Akira Sasanuma
bio: Akira Sasanuma (笹沼 晃, Sasanuma Akira, born March 25, 1973) is a Japanese voice actor (seiyu) from Tokyo who is affiliated with Arts Vision. He changed his stage name to Akira Sasanuma (笹沼 尭羅) around 2009, but returned to his former stage name Akira Sasanuma (笹沼 晃) around 2019. His hobbies and special skills are basketball, walking, and watching movies.
